text_block_list.text:
After the race, Tokai Teio returned
to the waiting room, but...
she wasn't her usual energetic self.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Running is fun, and getting praised
for winning makes me happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I just can't seem to stop sighing, you know~?
I wonder what's gotten into me...?"

Perhaps due to running in consecutive races,
Tokai Teio seems to be quite exhausted.
It might be best to reconsider the upcoming schedule.
